s: বইটির উদ্দেশ্য · What this book is for
এই বইয়ের দুটি লক্ষ্য:
চাইনিজ শেখা, একদম শূন্য থেকে HSK 4:
উচ্চারণ, টোন ও অক্ষর লেখা (Part 0), শব্দভান্ডার, ব্যাকরণ, অডিও QR কোড দিয়ে শোনা, Practice Ladder দিয়ে বলা, আর Appendix D-তে HSK পরীক্ষার গাইড।
পূর্ণাঙ্গ, বৈধ ও বন্ধুত্বভিত্তিক দাওয়াত:
কেন আল্লাহয় বিশ্বাস করব, প্রমাণ, আপত্তির উত্তর, চীনের প্রেক্ষাপট, আর তৈরি কথোপকথন।
প্রতিটা চাইনিজ বাক্যের সাথে পিনইন, ইংরেজি ও বাংলা অর্থ আছে, আর প্রতিটা অংশ শেষ হয় একটা বাংলা সারকথা দিয়ে।
This book has two goals:
Learn Chinese from zero to HSK 4:
pronunciation, tones and characters (Part 0), vocabulary, grammar, listening with the audio QR codes, speaking with the Practice Ladder, and the HSK exam guide in Appendix D.
Carry out complete, lawful, friendship-based dawah:
why believe, the evidence, answers to objections, the China context, and ready-made conversations.
Every Chinese sentence has pinyin, English and Bengali, and every section ends with a Bengali summary.

This book was written for a Muslim living in China who wants to answer two kinds of questions: the questions of people who do not believe in God, and the questions Chinese people ask about Islam. It was also written for someone still learning Chinese, so the language is taught alongside the message.

Three convictions shaped it. First, truth does not need exaggeration: every piece of evidence in this book is graded, and claims that careful Muslim scholars themselves reject have been left out or marked. Second, character comes before argument: most people are moved by a trustworthy friend long before they are moved by a proof. Third, China is not foreign soil for Islam: Muslims have lived here since 651, and Chinese Muslim scholars explained Islam in the language of Confucius more than three centuries ago. This book follows their path.

It is a working edition. Before you print or teach from it, ask a qualified scholar to review the religious content and a native Chinese speaker to review the Chinese (see the pre-publication checklist in Appendix B).
সারকথা:

বইটি চীনে থাকা একজন মুসলিমের জন্য, যে নাস্তিক ও চীনা বন্ধুদের প্রশ্নের উত্তর দিতে চায় আর একই সাথে চাইনিজ শিখছে। তিনটি নীতি: সত্যে অতিরঞ্জন নেই, যুক্তির আগে চরিত্র, আর চীন ইসলামের জন্য অপরিচিত মাটি নয়।

s.t: From zero to HSK 4: a one-year path

s: What this book can do, and what it cannot do alone.

It can teach you the sounds and tones, how characters work, the 1,089 HSK 1–4 words, the grammar of each level and the HSK exam format. It can give you dawah language at every level, and audio for every Chinese word in it. It cannot hear you. No book can correct your tones or your speaking, so you also need a teacher or a language partner. For full HSK exam practice, add the official sample papers and a mock test before each exam. If you can, study alongside a Chinese class or the standard HSK textbooks. This book then becomes the place where your Chinese and your dawah meet.
সৎ কথা:

এই বই দিয়ে একদম শূন্য থেকে শুরু করে HSK 4 পর্যন্ত যাওয়া যায়, আর প্রতিটা লেভেলে দাওয়াহর ভাষা শেখা যায়। কিন্তু বই তোমার উচ্চারণ শুনতে পারে না। তাই সপ্তাহে অন্তত একবার একজন শিক্ষক বা ভাষা-সঙ্গীর (语伴) সাথে কথা বলো, আর প্রতিটা পরীক্ষার আগে একটা mock test দাও।

s: Every week.

Study six days, 30–45 minutes a day: new words in the app, one section of the book, and five minutes of listening on the audio pages. On Friday, go to Jumu'ah and practise your phrases with Chinese Muslims. On Saturday, meet your language partner. On Sunday, review: do the exercises, tick the can-do list and take a short mock test.
Find a language partner (语伴 yǔbàn).
Most universities have Chinese students who want to practise English. A partner of the same gender is easiest for a Muslim student.
我们可以做语伴吗？我教你英语，你教我中文。(Wǒmen kěyǐ zuò yǔbàn ma? Wǒ jiāo nǐ Yīngyǔ, nǐ jiāo wǒ Zhōngwén.) "Can we be language partners? I'll teach you English and you teach me Chinese."

b.x: আমরা কি ভাষা-সঙ্গী হতে পারি? আমি তোমাকে ইংরেজি শেখাব, তুমি আমাকে চাইনিজ শেখাবে।

s: সারকথা:

এক বছরের পথ: প্রথম মাসে শূন্য থেকে HSK 1, তিন মাসে HSK 2, ছয় মাসে HSK 3, বারো মাসে HSK 4। প্রতিটা ধাপে বই, অ্যাপ আর দাওয়াহর দক্ষতা একসাথে চলে। সপ্তাহে একবার ভাষা-সঙ্গীর সাথে কথা বলা বাধ্যতামূলক মনে করো।

Where to start:

with no Chinese at all, begin with Part 0 (four weeks) and follow the one-year path below; at HSK 1–3, follow the Part VI roadmap first (VI.12, 20 minutes a day). When you finish Stage 3, move to the plan below.
Tone colours.
In the Word and print edition every pinyin syllable is coloured by its tone. Learn the five colours once and you will "see" the tone of every new word.

Citation style.

Numbers in square brackets, like [3], point to the numbered notes at the end of each chapter of Part I. Parts II, III and IV give their sources beside each item and in a Sources section at the end. Appendix B collects every source in one bibliography.

How the research was done.

The sources were collected on 27 October 2026 from the free dawah literature, academic publications and survey organisations. The research tools could search the web but could not open the pages in full, so each source was confirmed through the search engine's quoted extract. Open each link and check the wording before you cite it publicly.

s.t: Disclaimer, legal note and scholarly review

s: Not a fatwa.
This book summarises what established Muslim scholars and institutions have written; it is not a ruling. On any question of belief or practice, follow a qualified scholar.
Not legal advice.

Part I, Chapter 1 and Part IV, section 4 summarise the published rules on foreigners' religious activity in China as of October 2026. Rules and their enforcement change; check them yourself. This book is for your own study. Do not copy, print or distribute it to Chinese citizens, and do not post its content on Chinese platforms.
Chinese language.
The Chinese was prepared for a learner and has not yet been checked by a native speaker. Have a Chinese Muslim or teacher correct it before you rely on it in public.
Quran and hadith.
Check every Chinese verse against Ma Jian's printed translation and every hadith number at sunnah.com before quoting.
Humility.
If anything in this book is correct, it is from God; any error is from its compilers. Corrections are welcome and will be added to the next edition.
সারকথা:
এই বই ফতোয়া নয়, আইনি পরামর্শও নয়। এটা নিজের পড়ার জন্য: চীনা নাগরিকদের মধ্যে বিতরণ বা চীনা প্ল্যাটফর্মে পোস্ট কোরো না, আর ব্যবহারের আগে আলেম ও চীনা ভাষাভাষীকে দিয়ে যাচাই করিয়ে নাও।

This Part is for a student who knows no Chinese at all. In four weeks it teaches the sounds of Mandarin (pinyin and tones), how characters are built and written, how to type Chinese on your phone, numbers, dates, time and money, and twenty phrases for your first days in China. After it you can start Part VI, Stage 1, and the HSK 1 tab of your vocabulary app.
Good news for a Bengali speaker: Chinese separates "plain" and "breathy" consonants exactly as Bengali does (প/ফ, ত/থ, ক/খ, চ/ছ). Many sounds that are hard for English speakers are easy for you.
এই অংশে:
একদম শূন্য থেকে চাইনিজ: উচ্চারণ (pinyin আর টোন), অক্ষর কীভাবে লেখা হয়, ফোনে চাইনিজ টাইপ, সংখ্যা-তারিখ-সময়-টাকা, আর প্রথম দিনের ২০টা জরুরি বাক্য। চার সপ্তাহে শেষ করে Part VI-এর Stage 1 শুরু করো।
Characters, not letters.
Each character (汉字 hànzì) is one syllable and usually one meaning: 人 rén "person", 水 shuǐ "water". Most words have one or two characters: 学生 xuéshēng "student".
Pinyin
is the Latin spelling of the sound. You learn to speak with pinyin and to read with characters. Every Chinese sentence in this book has both.
Tones.
Every syllable has a pitch pattern, and the tone changes the meaning: mā 妈 "mother", mǎ 马 "horse". There are four tones and a light "neutral" tone.
No grammar endings.
Verbs never change: 我去 wǒ qù "I go", 他去 tā qù "he goes", 我昨天去了 "I went yesterday". Word order and small words such as 了, 吗 and 的 do the work.
Simplified characters.
Mainland China uses simplified characters (汉 rather than 漢). This book uses them throughout.
সারকথা:
চাইনিজে বর্ণমালা নেই, প্রতিটা অক্ষর একটা শব্দাংশ। উচ্চারণ শেখো pinyin দিয়ে, পড়া শেখো অক্ষর দিয়ে। টোন বদলালে অর্থ বদলায়, কিন্তু ক্রিয়ার রূপ কখনো বদলায় না।
A pinyin syllable =
initial
(the first consonant) +
final
(the rest) +
tone
. In
mā
, the initial is m, the final is a and the tone is the first tone.
The table compares each initial with the nearest Bengali sound. The most important column is the second one:
b, d, g, j, zh and z are NOT voiced
like Bengali ব, দ, গ, জ. They are plain unbreathed sounds, like প, ত, ক, চ. Their partners
p, t, k, q, ch and c
are the breathy ones, like ফ (with the lips), থ, খ, ছ.

soft শ, lips spread in a smile
চ with the tongue curled back
ছ with the tongue curled back
শ with the tongue curled back

s: Three pairs to watch:
z / zh (flat tongue / curled tongue), c / ch and s / sh. Say 四 sì "four" and 十 shí "ten" until a Chinese friend can tell them apart.
সারকথা:

b, d, g, j, zh, z উচ্চারণ করো প, ত, ক, চ-এর মতো, ব, দ, গ, জ-এর মতো নয়। আর p, t, k, q, ch, c হলো বাতাসওয়ালা ফ, থ, খ, ছ। s সবসময় "স", কখনো "শ" নয়। z/zh, c/ch, s/sh-এ জিভ সমান না বাঁকানো, সেটা খেয়াল রাখো।

অ with spread lips (between এ and অ)
i after z, c, s, zh, ch, sh, r
ü (written u after j, q, x, y)

s: Two spelling rules.
After j, q, x and y the two dots of ü are dropped (xué, qù, yún), but the sound is still ü. On a phone keyboard you type ü as
v
(nǚ = nv).
সারকথা:
বেশিরভাগ final বাংলা স্বরের মতো। তিনটা জিনিস নতুন: zh/ch/sh/z/c/s-এর পরের "i" (গুঞ্জনের মতো শব্দ), ü (ঠোঁট গোল করে ই), আর ian-এর উচ্চারণ "ইয়েন"।

s: Three tone-change rules.
Pinyin in this book already shows the changed tone, so you only need to recognise them.
Two third tones:
the first becomes second. 你好 nǐ + hǎo is said
ní hǎo
不 bù
becomes
bú
before a fourth tone: 不是
bú shì
, 不去
bú qù
一 yī
becomes
yì
before tones 1, 2 and 3 (一天 yì tiān) and
yí
before tone 4 (一个 yí ge). When counting or in dates it stays yī.
Daily drill (two minutes).
Read across the table aloud: mā má mǎ mà ma, then bā bá bǎ bà ba, then the pairs 真主 Zhēnzhǔ / 珍珠 zhēnzhū and 主 zhǔ / 猪 zhū (see VI.10). The audio page for this Part plays every example.
সারকথা:

চারটা টোন: উঁচু-সমান, উপরে-ওঠা, নিচু-বাঁকা, আর হঠাৎ-নামা, সাথে একটা হালকা টোন। দুটো তৃতীয় টোন পাশাপাশি এলে প্রথমটা দ্বিতীয় হয়ে যায় (你好 = ní hǎo)। 不 আর 一-এর টোনও বদলায়, বইয়ের pinyin-এ এটা আগেই দেখানো আছে।
Eight basic strokes.
Every character is built from these.
Six stroke-order rules.
Top before bottom: 三.
Left before right: 你, 他.
Horizontal before vertical when they cross: 十.
Left-falling before right-falling: 人, 八.
Outside before inside, and close the box last: 回, 国.
Middle before the two sides: 小, 水.
Radicals.
Most characters have a "radical", a part that hints at the meaning. Learn these twenty and new characters stop looking random.

s: The word for prayer, 礼拜 lǐbài, begins with the "altar" radical 礻. Many religious words share it: 祈祷 qídǎo "to pray", 神 shén "god".
How to practise writing.

Write each new character five times while saying its sound and meaning aloud. Your vocabulary app's word cards show how characters break into parts. For stroke-by-stroke animations, use a dictionary app such as Pleco.

s.t: Chapter 1: Dawah in China: method, manners and the law

s: Most Chinese people are not committed atheists. About 10% of Chinese adults formally identify with a religion, yet 47% believe in fengshui and 33% believe in the Buddha or a bodhisattva [1]. Many were taught atheism at school but still speak of fate (命 mìng), Heaven (天 tiān) and ancestors. Most have never thought seriously about God. Your first task is rarely to defeat atheism; it is to help someone think about the question for the first time.

Confucian values (honesty, respect for parents, modesty, family, self-discipline) are close to Islamic values, and Chinese Muslim scholars used them as a bridge 350 years ago [2]. Islam has been in China since 651 CE [3]. You are not bringing something foreign; you are pointing to something already part of China's story.

b.x: 1.2 The law: what you may and may not do

s: Two sets of rules apply to you as a foreigner: the Regulations on Religious Affairs (in force since 1 February 2018) and the Detailed Rules on the religious activities of foreigners (National Religious Affairs Administration Order No. 23, in force since 1 May 2025) [4].
You may
attend a registered mosque, join foreigner-only gatherings at approved venues, bring a few religious books for personal use, and live your faith openly.
You may not

preach without authorisation, recruit Chinese citizens as followers, distribute or sell religious materials, set up any religious group or class, or post religious content online for Chinese audiences.

In practice: build friendships, answer questions people ask you, and when someone is seriously interested, introduce them to the ahong (imam) at a registered mosque. Never discuss Xinjiang or politics. Protect yourself and the people you talk to. Part IV, section 4 gives the details.
“Invite to the way of your Lord with wisdom and good instruction, and argue with them in a way that is best” (Quran 16:125). In practice:
Friendship first.
Share food (halal food is a natural topic), help people, be reliable. Chinese culture trusts people before arguments.
Ask questions, do not lecture.
“Do you think the universe has a beginning?” works better than a speech.
Agree where you can.
“Yes, science is important. Islam commands us to study it.” Then add the one point they are missing.
One idea per conversation.
Leave them with one thing to think about, not twenty.
Respect Chinese civilisation.
Never mock the Buddha, Confucius or China. Quote Confucius correctly and you earn respect immediately [2].
Admit what you do not know.
“Good question, let me find the answer” builds more trust than a weak answer.
Use only evidence that survives checking.
A Chinese student with a phone will check your claim in thirty seconds. Part II grades every piece of evidence; use the strong ones [5].
Guidance is from God.
“You cannot guide whom you love, but God guides whom He wills” (Quran 28:56). Your duty is to deliver the message clearly and kindly; results are not your responsibility.
我不是想说服你，我只是想和你一起思考这个问题。
Wǒ bú shì xiǎng shuōfú nǐ, wǒ zhǐ shì xiǎng hé nǐ yìqǐ sīkǎo zhège wèntí.
“I am not trying to convince you; I just want to think about this question together with you.”

s.t: Chapter 2: Why believe in God: six arguments

s: You do not need all six. Learn the first two deeply; they are enough for most conversations. The others are for people who push further. The Chinese course teaches these in Lessons 3 and 4.

b.x: 2.1 The universe began, so it needs a cause

s: Everything that begins to exist has a cause. Nothing comes from nothing.

The universe began to exist. Modern cosmology places the beginning of space, time and matter about 13.8 billion years ago, and the Borde-Guth-Vilenkin theorem shows that any universe that has on average been expanding cannot be infinite in the past [1].

Therefore the universe has a cause. That cause is outside space, time and matter: timeless, non-physical, immensely powerful, and it chose to create, because a timeless cause producing a universe that begins in time implies a will. This is what we call God.

Quran 52:35-36: “Were they created by nothing, or were they the creators? Or did they create the heavens and the earth? No, they have no certainty.” The three options (from nothing, self-created, created by a Creator) are the whole debate in two verses [2].
中文:

宇宙有开始。有开始的东西一定有原因。所以宇宙有一个超越时间和空间的创造者。(Yǔzhòu yǒu kāishǐ. Yǒu kāishǐ de dōngxi yídìng yǒu yuányīn. Suǒyǐ yǔzhòu yǒu yí ge chāoyuè shíjiān hé kōngjiān de chuàngzàozhě.) “The universe had a beginning. Whatever begins must have a cause. So the universe has a Creator beyond time and space.”

b.x: মহাবিশ্বের একটা শুরু আছে। যার শুরু আছে, তার অবশ্যই একটা কারণ আছে। তাই মহাবিশ্বের একজন স্রষ্টা আছেন, যিনি সময় ও স্থানের ঊর্ধ্বে।
2.2 The universe is fine-tuned for life

s: The constants of physics sit inside very narrow ranges. The cosmological constant is often described as tuned to about one part in 10^120; a small change in the strength of the strong nuclear force would prevent the formation of carbon or of stable atoms [3].
There are three explanations: chance, necessity or design. Chance of this size is not a serious answer. Physics does not say the constants had to have these values. Design is the natural reading.
The multiverse is the usual escape, but it is unobserved, and a universe-generator would itself need fine-tuning, which moves the problem up one level [4].
Quran 67:3: “You do not see in the creation of the Most Merciful any inconsistency. So return your vision to the sky: do you see any flaw?”
中文:

物理常数非常精确，稍微改变一点，生命就不可能存在。这不像巧合，更像设计。(Wùlǐ chángshù fēicháng jīngquè, shāowēi gǎibiàn yìdiǎn, shēngmìng jiù bù kěnéng cúnzài. Zhè bú xiàng qiǎohé, gèng xiàng shèjì.) “The physical constants are extremely precise. Change them slightly and life is impossible. This does not look like coincidence; it looks like design.”

b.x: পদার্থবিজ্ঞানের ধ্রুবকগুলো অত্যন্ত নিখুঁত; সামান্য বদলালেই জীবন টিকে থাকা অসম্ভব। এটা কাকতালীয় মনে হয় না, বরং পরিকল্পনা মনে হয়।

s: DNA is a code: four chemical letters, about three billion of them in the human genome, read by molecular machines with error correction [5]. Every code whose origin we know comes from a mind.
Evolution, even if fully true, explains how life changes, not how the first self-copying life or the laws that allow it began. The origin of life remains an open problem in science [6].
The Quran commands reflection on creation as a path to faith (3:190-191) and describes the stages of the embryo (23:12-14).
中文:
DNA 是一种密码。我们知道来源的所有密码都来自智慧。(DNA shì yì zhǒng mìmǎ. Wǒmen zhīdào láiyuán de suǒyǒu mìmǎ dōu láizì zhìhuì.) “DNA is a code. Every code whose source we know comes from intelligence.”

b.x: DNA এক ধরনের সংকেত (কোড)। যেসব সংকেতের উৎস আমরা জানি, সেগুলো সবই কোনো বুদ্ধিমান সত্তা থেকে এসেছে।

s: Almost everyone agrees that torturing a child for fun is really wrong, not just unfashionable. That is an objective moral fact.
Without God, morality is only chemistry, culture or a survival strategy. Then “wrong” means “most people dislike it”, and a society that decides otherwise is not actually wrong.
Objective moral duties make sense if there is a Lawgiver above all humans. Atheists can be good people; the point is that atheism cannot explain why goodness is binding [7].

Chinese bridge: Mencius taught that humans are born with a good conscience (良心 liángxīn) and innate moral knowledge (良知 liángzhī) [8]. Islam calls this the fitrah, the nature God placed in every person (Quran 30:30).
中文:

如果没有真主，善恶只是个人意见。但我们都知道，有些事是真正的错。(Rúguǒ méiyǒu Zhēnzhǔ, shàn'è zhǐ shì gèrén yìjiàn. Dàn wǒmen dōu zhīdào, yǒu xiē shì shì zhēnzhèng de cuò.) “If there is no God, good and evil are only opinion. But we all know some things are truly wrong.”

b.x: যদি আল্লাহ না থাকেন, তাহলে ভালো-মন্দ শুধু ব্যক্তিগত মত। কিন্তু আমরা সবাই জানি, কিছু কাজ সত্যিই অন্যায়।

s: Atoms do not think, feel or understand. No physical description captures what it is like to experience something; philosophers call this the hard problem of consciousness [9].

If the mind were only atoms moved by physical laws, your beliefs, including atheism, would be the result of chemistry, not reasoning. Why trust them? A self that understands truth points beyond matter. Islam teaches that the soul is from God's command (Quran 17:85).
中文:
原子不会思考。为什么你会？(Yuánzǐ bú huì sīkǎo. Wèishénme nǐ huì?) “Atoms cannot think. Why can you?”

b.x: পরমাণু চিন্তা করতে পারে না। তাহলে তুমি পারো কেন?
2.6 The fitrah: belief is natural, atheism is learned

s: Children across cultures naturally see purpose and a maker behind the world; psychologists have described them as “intuitive theists” [10]. Almost every civilisation in history believed in a higher power. Atheism must be taught.
The Prophet said: “Every child is born upon the fitrah” [11]. In danger, even people who deny God call on Him (Quran 10:22, 29:65).
Chinese people say 谢天谢地 (“thank heaven and earth”) and 老天爷 (“Old Heavenly Lord”). This is the fitrah speaking through the language.
中文:

你们说“老天爷”、“谢天谢地”。你们的心其实已经知道有一个更高的主宰。(Nǐmen shuō “Lǎotiānyé”, “xiè tiān xiè dì”. Nǐmen de xīn qíshí yǐjīng zhīdào yǒu yí ge gèng gāo de zhǔzǎi.) “You say ‘Old Heavenly Lord’ and ‘thank heaven and earth’. Your heart already knows there is a higher Master.”

b.x: তোমরা বলো “লাওথিয়েনইয়ে” (বুড়ো আসমানি প্রভু) আর “আসমান-জমিনকে ধন্যবাদ”। তোমাদের মন আসলে আগে থেকেই জানে যে একজন উচ্চতর প্রভু আছেন।

সারকথা:

আল্লাহর অস্তিত্বের ছয়টি যুক্তি: মহাবিশ্বের শুরু, সূক্ষ্ম সমন্বয়, DNA-র তথ্য, নৈতিকতা, চেতনা আর ফিতরাত। প্রথম দুটি ভালো করে শেখো; তাহলে চীনা ভাষায় বলতে পারবে: “মহাবিশ্বের শুরু আছে, তাই এর একজন স্রষ্টা আছেন।”
Each answer gives the English explanation, then a short Chinese reply you can say. Part III has 44 objections in more depth.

b.x: Q1. “If everything needs a cause, who created God?” 谁创造了真主？

s: The argument never said “everything needs a cause”. It said “everything that
begins

needs a cause”. God does not begin; He is eternal and outside time. Asking “who created the uncreated?” is like asking “what is north of the North Pole?”. An endless chain of creators is impossible too: if every creator needed a creator, nothing would ever start, like a line of soldiers each waiting for the one behind to fire first. The chain must end in one uncreated Creator [1]. Quran 112:3: “He neither begets nor is born.”
中文:

我们说的是“有开始的东西需要原因”。真主没有开始，他是永恒的，在时间之外。如果每个创造者都需要创造者，那什么都不会存在。(Wǒmen shuō de shì “yǒu kāishǐ de dōngxi xūyào yuányīn”. Zhēnzhǔ méiyǒu kāishǐ, tā shì yǒnghéng de, zài shíjiān zhī wài. Rúguǒ měi ge chuàngzàozhě dōu xūyào chuàngzàozhě, nà shénme dōu bú huì cúnzài.) “We say “whatever has a beginning needs a cause”. God has no beginning; He is eternal, outside time. If every creator needed a creator, nothing would exist.”

b.x: আমরা বলি, “যার শুরু আছে, তার কারণ দরকার।” আল্লাহর কোনো শুরু নেই; তিনি চিরন্তন, সময়ের বাইরে। প্রত্যেক স্রষ্টার যদি আরেকজন স্রষ্টা লাগত, তাহলে কিছুই অস্তিত্বে আসত না।
Q2. “Science explains everything. Religion is unscientific.” 科学能解释一切

s: Science explains
how

things work inside the universe. It cannot explain why the universe exists, why its laws exist, why mathematics describes it, or what is right and wrong. “Only science gives knowledge” is itself not a scientific statement; no experiment proves it. Islam has no conflict with science: the first word revealed was “Read” (96:1). Ibn al-Haytham's
Book of Optics
(c. 1011-1021) used systematic experiment centuries before Europe; the word “algebra” comes from al-Khwarizmi's book
al-Jabr
(c. 820); Ibn Sina's
Canon of Medicine
was taught in European universities for 500 years [2]. Many scientists believe in God, including Francis Collins, who led the Human Genome Project [3].
中文:

科学解释宇宙怎么运行，但不能解释宇宙为什么存在。伊斯兰鼓励科学，《古兰经》的第一个字是“诵读”。“代数”这个词就来自穆斯林科学家。(Kēxué jiěshì yǔzhòu zěnme yùnxíng, dàn bù néng jiěshì yǔzhòu wèishénme cúnzài. Yīsīlán gǔlì kēxué, 《Gǔlánjīng》 de dì-yī ge zì shì “sòngdú”. “Dàishù” zhège cí jiù láizì Mùsīlín kēxuéjiā.) “Science explains how the universe works, but not why the universe exists. Islam encourages science; the first word of the Quran is “Read”. The word “algebra” comes from a Muslim scientist.”

b.x: বিজ্ঞান ব্যাখ্যা করে মহাবিশ্ব কীভাবে চলে, কিন্তু মহাবিশ্ব কেন আছে তা ব্যাখ্যা করতে পারে না। ইসলাম বিজ্ঞানকে উৎসাহ দেয়; কুরআনের প্রথম শব্দ “পড়ো”। “অ্যালজেবরা” (বীজগণিত) শব্দটি এসেছে একজন মুসলিম বিজ্ঞানীর কাছ থেকে।
Q3. “Evolution proves there is no God.” 进化论证明没有神
“বিবর্তনবাদ প্রমাণ করে যে কোনো স্রষ্টা নেই।”

s: Evolution, even if accepted completely, describes a process. A process needs laws, a starting point and a universe that allows it. It does not explain where the first life, the laws or the universe came from. Natural selection is not a creator; it only removes what fails. Muslim scholars hold that nothing in scripture denies common ancestry for other life; Adam's special creation is a claim about one lineage that science, which studies regularities, cannot rule out [4]. The real question is whether the whole system (universe, laws and life) is an accident or a creation.
中文:

就算进化论完全正确，它也只是一个过程。过程需要规律和起点。进化论不能解释第一个生命从哪里来，也不能解释宇宙从哪里来。(Jiùsuàn jìnhuàlùn wánquán zhèngquè, tā yě zhǐ shì yí ge guòchéng. Guòchéng xūyào guīlǜ hé qǐdiǎn. Jìnhuàlùn bù néng jiěshì dì-yī ge shēngmìng cóng nǎlǐ lái, yě bù néng jiěshì yǔzhòu cóng nǎlǐ lái.) “Even if evolution is completely correct, it is only a process. A process needs laws and a starting point. Evolution cannot explain where the first life came from, or where the universe came from.”

b.x: বিবর্তনবাদ পুরোপুরি সঠিক হলেও এটা কেবল একটা প্রক্রিয়া। প্রক্রিয়ার জন্য নিয়ম আর একটা শুরুর বিন্দু লাগে। প্রথম প্রাণ কোথা থেকে এল, মহাবিশ্ব কোথা থেকে এল, বিবর্তনবাদ তা ব্যাখ্যা করতে পারে না।
Q4. “The Big Bang created everything. No God needed.” 宇宙大爆炸创造了一切

s: The Big Bang is evidence for a beginning, which supports a Creator. Before it was accepted in the 1960s, many atheists preferred an eternal universe. An explosion is an event, not a cause: what caused it? And the “nothing” of popular physics books, the quantum vacuum, is not nothing; it is a field with laws and energy that itself needs explaining [5]. Quran 21:30: “Do the disbelievers not see that the heavens and the earth were a joined entity, and We separated them?”
中文:

大爆炸是一个事件，不是一个原因。是什么引起了大爆炸？大爆炸说明宇宙有开始，这正是有创造者的证据。(Dàbàozhà shì yí ge shìjiàn, bú shì yí ge yuányīn. Shì shénme yǐnqǐ le dàbàozhà? Dàbàozhà shuōmíng yǔzhòu yǒu kāishǐ, zhè zhèng shì yǒu chuàngzàozhě de zhèngjù.) “The Big Bang is an event, not a cause. What caused the Big Bang? The Big Bang shows the universe has a beginning, and that is exactly evidence for a Creator.”

b.x: মহাবিস্ফোরণ (বিগ ব্যাং) একটা ঘটনা, কারণ নয়। মহাবিস্ফোরণ ঘটাল কে? মহাবিস্ফোরণ দেখায় যে মহাবিশ্বের শুরু আছে, আর এটাই স্রষ্টা থাকার প্রমাণ।
Q5. “I cannot see God, so there is no evidence.” 我看不见真主

s: You cannot see gravity, electrons, the past, your own mind or your parents' love. You know them from their effects. We know the Creator from His effects: the universe, its order, its laws, our conscience. A watch proves a watchmaker even if you never meet him. The Quran praises those who “believe in the unseen” (2:3) on the basis of signs, not blind faith. And if God were a visible object inside the universe, He would be part of creation, not the Creator.
中文:

你也看不见引力、看不见电子、看不见你自己的思想，但你相信它们存在，因为你看到了它们的作用。我们通过创造认识创造者。(Nǐ yě kàn bú jiàn yǐnlì, kàn bú jiàn diànzǐ, kàn bú jiàn nǐ zìjǐ de sīxiǎng, dàn nǐ xiāngxìn tāmen cúnzài, yīnwèi nǐ kàndào le tāmen de zuòyòng. Wǒmen tōngguò chuàngzào rènshi chuàngzàozhě.) “You cannot see gravity, electrons or your own thoughts either, but you believe they exist because you see their effects. We know the Creator through creation.”

b.x: তুমিও মাধ্যাকর্ষণ, ইলেকট্রন বা নিজের চিন্তা দেখতে পাও না, তবু বিশ্বাস করো এগুলো আছে, কারণ তুমি এদের প্রভাব দেখো। আমরা সৃষ্টির মাধ্যমে স্রষ্টাকে চিনি।
Q6. “If God is good and powerful, why is there suffering?” 为什么有痛苦？

s: This is the most emotional question, so answer gently [6]:
Suffering disproves God only if God could have no good reason to allow it. A limited human cannot see all reasons, just as a child cannot understand why a doctor gives an injection.

This life is a test, not paradise (Quran 67:2). Free will means people can choose evil, and most suffering comes from human choices: war, greed, oppression. Remove free will and you remove love, courage and every virtue.
Suffering produces patience, compassion and humility. The Prophet said no hardship, illness or sorrow befalls a believer without God removing some of his sins by it [7].
Islam promises perfect justice in the next life: every wrong repaid, every pain compensated (Quran 99:7-8). Atheism has no answer at all: the victim simply dies and the oppressor wins.
中文:

这个世界是考验，不是天堂。大部分痛苦来自人的选择。如果没有真主，受害者永远得不到公正。伊斯兰说，每一个不公都会在后世得到公正。(Zhège shìjiè shì kǎoyàn, bú shì tiāntáng. Dàbùfen tòngkǔ láizì rén de xuǎnzé. Rúguǒ méiyǒu Zhēnzhǔ, shòuhàizhě yǒngyuǎn dé bú dào gōngzhèng. Yīsīlán shuō, měi yí ge bùgōng dōu huì zài hòushì dédào gōngzhèng.) “This world is a test, not paradise. Most suffering comes from human choices. If there is no God, victims never get justice. Islam says every injustice will receive justice in the next life.”

b.x: এই দুনিয়া পরীক্ষা, জান্নাত নয়। বেশিরভাগ কষ্ট আসে মানুষের নিজের সিদ্ধান্ত থেকে। আল্লাহ না থাকলে নির্যাতিতরা কখনো ন্যায়বিচার পাবে না। ইসলাম বলে, প্রতিটি অবিচারের ন্যায়বিচার আখিরাতে হবে।
Q7. “Religion causes war and hatred.” 宗教引起战争

s: The
Encyclopedia of Wars

lists 1,763 wars in history and classes 123 of them, about 7%, as religious [8]. The deadliest century was the 20th, dominated by secular ideologies [9]. People fight over land, power and money and sometimes use religion as a flag. Islam forbids killing innocents (5:32: killing one innocent is like killing all mankind), forbids forced conversion (2:256), and commands justice even toward enemies (5:8). Judge Islam by its texts, not by people who break them.
In China, make the general point (ideologies have killed more than religions) and move on. Do not criticise the Chinese state.
中文:

历史上只有大约百分之七的战争是因为宗教。人为了土地、权力和钱而战争。《古兰经》说：杀一个无辜的人，就像杀了全人类。(Lìshǐ shang zhǐ yǒu dàyuē bǎi fēn zhī qī de zhànzhēng shì yīnwèi zōngjiào. Rén wèi le tǔdì, quánlì hé qián ér zhànzhēng. 《Gǔlánjīng》 shuō: shā yí ge wúgū de rén, jiù xiàng shā le quán rénlèi.) “In history only about 7% of wars were because of religion. People fight for land, power and money. The Quran says: killing one innocent person is like killing all humanity.”

b.x: ইতিহাসে মাত্র প্রায় সাত শতাংশ যুদ্ধ হয়েছে ধর্মের কারণে। মানুষ যুদ্ধ করে জমি, ক্ষমতা আর টাকার জন্য। কুরআন বলে: একজন নিরপরাধ মানুষকে হত্যা করা যেন গোটা মানবজাতিকে হত্যা করা।
Q8. “I can be a good person without religion.” 没有宗教我也可以是好人
“ধর্ম ছাড়াও আমি ভালো মানুষ হতে পারি।”

s: Agree warmly: yes, you can, because God gave every human a conscience. But two questions follow. First, why be good when nobody is watching and being bad would benefit you? Atheism has no answer except personal taste. Second, who defines “good”? Societies have disagreed (slavery was once called good); without a standard above humans, “good” changes with fashion [10]. And being good is not the whole purpose of life. The purpose is to know and thank the One who gave you life.
中文:

是的，你可以是好人，因为真主给了每个人良心。但是，谁来定义“好”？还有，人生的目的不只是做好人，还要认识和感谢给你生命的那一位。(Shì de, nǐ kěyǐ shì hǎorén, yīnwèi Zhēnzhǔ gěi le měi ge rén liángxīn. Dànshì, shéi lái dìngyì “hǎo”? Háiyǒu, rénshēng de mùdì bù zhǐ shì zuò hǎorén, hái yào rènshi hé gǎnxiè gěi nǐ shēngmìng de nà yí wèi.) “Yes, you can be a good person, because God gave everyone a conscience. But who defines “good”? And the purpose of life is not only to be a good person, but also to know and thank the One who gave you life.”

b.x: হ্যাঁ, তুমি ভালো মানুষ হতে পারো, কারণ আল্লাহ প্রত্যেক মানুষকে বিবেক দিয়েছেন। কিন্তু “ভালো” কী, তা ঠিক করবে কে? তা ছাড়া জীবনের উদ্দেশ্য শুধু ভালো মানুষ হওয়া নয়; যিনি তোমাকে জীবন দিয়েছেন, তাঁকে চেনা আর তাঁর শুকরিয়া আদায় করাও।
Q9. “There are thousands of religions. They cannot all be right.” 那么多宗教，哪个是对的？

s: Many answers do not mean no answer is right; a maths problem has many wrong answers and one right one. Most religions agree on the core: a higher power, a purpose, a judgement. Islam's position is that God sent the same message to every people (“there was no nation but a warner passed among them”, 35:24; also 16:36), people changed it over time, and the Quran is the final, preserved version. So the question is not “which of 4,000 religions?” but “which message about the One God is still unchanged?”
中文:

有很多答案，不等于没有正确答案。数学题有很多错的答案，但只有一个对的。伊斯兰说，真主给每个民族都派过使者，传的是同一个信息。(Yǒu hěn duō dá'àn, bù děngyú méiyǒu zhèngquè dá'àn. Shùxué tí yǒu hěn duō cuò de dá'àn, dàn zhǐ yǒu yí ge duì de. Yīsīlán shuō, Zhēnzhǔ gěi měi ge mínzú dōu pài guò shǐzhě, chuán de shì tóng yí ge xìnxī.) “Many answers do not mean there is no right answer. A maths problem has many wrong answers but only one right one. Islam says God sent messengers to every people, carrying the same message.”

b.x: অনেক উত্তর থাকা মানে সঠিক উত্তর নেই, তা নয়। অঙ্কের একটা প্রশ্নের অনেক ভুল উত্তর হয়, কিন্তু সঠিক উত্তর একটাই। ইসলাম বলে, আল্লাহ প্রত্যেক জাতির কাছে রাসূল পাঠিয়েছেন, সবাই একই বার্তা এনেছেন।
Q10. “You only believe because you were born into it.” 你信教只是因为你生在那里
b.id: q10-you-only-believe-because-you-were-born-into-it-你信教只是因为你生在那里

b.x: “তুমি ধর্ম মানো শুধু এজন্য যে তুমি সেখানে জন্মেছ।”

s: This is the genetic fallacy: where a belief came from says nothing about whether it is true. A Chinese atheist believes what Chinese schools taught; that does not make atheism true or false either. People also enter Islam as adults from every background, including former atheists and scientists (Part II, section 8). Turn it into a question: “Have you examined what you were taught?”
中文:

你不信教，也是因为你生在中国，学校这样教你。一个信念从哪里来，和它对不对是两件事。重要的是：你有没有自己认真想过？(Nǐ bú xìnjiào, yě shì yīnwèi nǐ shēng zài Zhōngguó, xuéxiào zhèyàng jiāo nǐ. Yí ge xìnniàn cóng nǎlǐ lái, hé tā duì bú duì shì liǎng jiàn shì. Zhòngyào de shì: nǐ yǒu méiyǒu zìjǐ rènzhēn xiǎng guo?) “You do not believe in religion also because you were born in China and school taught you so. Where a belief comes from and whether it is right are two different things. What matters is: have you thought about it seriously yourself?”

b.x: তুমি যে ধর্ম মানো না, সেটাও তো এজন্য যে তুমি চীনে জন্মেছ আর স্কুল তোমাকে এভাবে শিখিয়েছে। একটা বিশ্বাস কোথা থেকে এল আর সেটা সঠিক কি না, এ দুটো আলাদা ব্যাপার। আসল কথা হলো: তুমি নিজে কি কখনো গুরুত্ব দিয়ে ভেবেছ?
Q11. “Religion is the opium of the people, for the weak and uneducated.” 宗教是人民的鸦片

s: Marx's line (1844) is a sociological opinion, not an argument about whether God exists; the same sentence calls religion “the sigh of the oppressed creature” [11]. The Quran commands knowledge: “Are those who know equal to those who do not know?” (39:9). The University of al-Qarawiyyin in Fez, founded by a Muslim woman, Fatima al-Fihri, in 859, is recognised as the oldest existing, continually operating degree-granting institution in the world [12]. Comfort is not the test of truth, and the charge reverses: believing there will be no judgement is very comforting for someone who wants to do as he likes. Religion is not a crutch but a map: where you came from and where you are going.
中文:

《古兰经》说：“有知识的人和没有知识的人能相等吗？”世界上至今还在办学的最古老的大学，是一位穆斯林女性创办的。宗教不是拐杖，是地图：告诉你从哪里来，到哪里去。(《Gǔlánjīng》 shuō: “Yǒu zhīshi de rén hé méiyǒu zhīshi de rén néng xiāngděng ma?” Shìjiè shang zhìjīn hái zài bànxué de zuì gǔlǎo de dàxué, shì yí wèi Mùsīlín nǚxìng chuàngbàn de. Zōngjiào bú shì guǎizhàng, shì dìtú: gàosu nǐ cóng nǎlǐ lái, dào nǎlǐ qù.) “The Quran says: “Are those who have knowledge equal to those who do not?” The oldest university in the world still teaching today was founded by a Muslim woman. Religion is not a crutch but a map: it tells you where you came from and where you are going.”

b.x: কুরআন বলে: “যারা জানে আর যারা জানে না, তারা কি সমান হতে পারে?” পৃথিবীতে এখনো চালু থাকা সবচেয়ে পুরোনো বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়টি একজন মুসলিম নারী প্রতিষ্ঠা করেছিলেন। ধর্ম ক্রাচ নয়, মানচিত্র: তুমি কোথা থেকে এসেছ আর কোথায় যাচ্ছ, তা বলে দেয়।
Q12. “Why does God need our worship? Is He insecure?” 真主为什么需要我们崇拜他？
b.id: q12-why-does-god-need-our-worship-is-he-insecure-真主为什么需要我们崇拜他

s: God needs nothing: “You are the ones in need of God; God is Free of need” (35:15; also 51:56-57). Worship benefits us, not Him. The sun does not need you to face it, but you need it to feel warm. Worship is gratitude to the One who gave you eyes, parents and every breath; it reminds you of your purpose and keeps you humble and honest [13]. Chinese culture honours parents out of gratitude (孝 xiào); worship is gratitude to the Source of everything.
中文:

真主不需要任何东西。崇拜是为了我们自己，不是为了他。就像你孝敬父母，是因为感恩。崇拜是对给了我们一切的主的感恩。(Zhēnzhǔ bù xūyào rènhé dōngxi. Chóngbài shì wèi le wǒmen zìjǐ, bú shì wèi le tā. Jiù xiàng nǐ xiàojìng fùmǔ, shì yīnwèi gǎn'ēn. Chóngbài shì duì gěi le wǒmen yíqiè de Zhǔ de gǎn'ēn.) “God needs nothing. Worship is for our own sake, not for His. Just as you honour your parents out of gratitude, worship is gratitude to the Lord who gave us everything.”

b.x: আল্লাহর কোনো কিছুর প্রয়োজন নেই। ইবাদত আমাদের নিজেদের জন্য, তাঁর জন্য নয়। যেমন তুমি কৃতজ্ঞতা থেকে বাবা-মায়ের সেবা ও সম্মান করো, তেমনি ইবাদত হলো সেই প্রভুর প্রতি কৃতজ্ঞতা, যিনি আমাদের সবকিছু দিয়েছেন।
Q13. “A loving God would not send people to hell.” 慈爱的神不会把人送进地狱
b.id: q13-a-loving-god-would-not-send-people-to-hell-慈爱的神不会把人送进地狱

s: A loving God is also a just God. Would you call a judge “loving” if he let every murderer walk free? God's mercy is greater: “My mercy prevails over My wrath” [14]; He forgives all sins for anyone who sincerely repents (39:53); and those whom the message never clearly reached are not punished for it (17:15). Hell is for knowing, persistent rejection and evil, after reason, conscience and messengers were given [15]. Islam does not say good non-Muslims and evil people are the same; God judges each person by what they knew and what they did.
中文:

慈爱的主也是公正的主。如果法官让所有杀人犯都自由，你会说他慈爱吗？真主原谅所有真心悔改的人。没有听到过信息的人，不会因此被惩罚。(Cí'ài de Zhǔ yě shì gōngzhèng de Zhǔ. Rúguǒ fǎguān ràng suǒyǒu shārénfàn dōu zìyóu, nǐ huì shuō tā cí'ài ma? Zhēnzhǔ yuánliàng suǒyǒu zhēnxīn huǐgǎi de rén. Méiyǒu tīng dào guo xìnxī de rén, bú huì yīncǐ bèi chéngfá.) “The loving Lord is also the just Lord. If a judge set every murderer free, would you call him loving? God forgives everyone who sincerely repents. Those who never heard the message will not be punished for that.”

b.x: দয়াময় প্রভু ন্যায়বিচারকও। কোনো বিচারক যদি সব খুনিকে ছেড়ে দেন, তুমি কি তাঁকে দয়ালু বলবে? যে আন্তরিকভাবে তওবা করে, আল্লাহ তাকে ক্ষমা করেন। যারা কখনো এই বার্তা শোনেনি, তাদের সে কারণে শাস্তি দেওয়া হবে না।
Q14. “If God knows everything, we have no free will.” 真主知道一切，那我们没有自由
b.id: q14-if-god-knows-everything-we-have-no-free-will-真主知道一切那我们没有自由

b.x: “আল্লাহ যদি সব জানেন, তাহলে তো আমাদের স্বাধীনতা নেই।”

s: Knowing is not forcing. A teacher who knows a lazy student will fail did not make him fail. God is outside time; He sees your choice but does not make it for you. The Quran says “whoever wills, let him believe, and whoever wills, let him disbelieve” (18:29) [16]. The atheist has the bigger problem: if we are only atoms following physical laws, there is no free will at all, and even his atheism was not freely chosen.
中文:

知道不等于强迫。老师知道懒学生会不及格，但不是老师让他不及格的。真主看见你的选择，但选择是你自己做的。(Zhīdào bù děngyú qiǎngpò. Lǎoshī zhīdào lǎn xuésheng huì bù jígé, dàn bú shì lǎoshī ràng tā bù jígé de. Zhēnzhǔ kànjiàn nǐ de xuǎnzé, dàn xuǎnzé shì nǐ zìjǐ zuò de.) “Knowing is not forcing. A teacher knows a lazy student will fail, but it is not the teacher who makes him fail. God sees your choice, but you make the choice yourself.”

b.x: জানা মানে বাধ্য করা নয়। শিক্ষক জানেন অলস ছাত্রটি ফেল করবে, কিন্তু শিক্ষক তাকে ফেল করাননি। আল্লাহ তোমার সিদ্ধান্ত দেখেন, কিন্তু সিদ্ধান্তটা তুমি নিজেই নাও।
Q15. “Miracles are impossible. The laws of nature never break.” 奇迹不可能

s: The laws of nature describe what normally happens; they are not a fence around God. If God made the laws, He can act beyond them, as a programmer can change his own program. Saying “miracles are impossible” assumes there is no God, which is the question being discussed [17]. Islam's main miracle is not a one-time event you must take on trust; it is the Quran, a book you can examine today (Chapter 4).
中文:

自然规律是真主创造的。写程序的人当然可以改程序。伊斯兰最大的奇迹是《古兰经》，你今天还可以自己去检验。(Zìrán guīlǜ shì Zhēnzhǔ chuàngzào de. Xiě chéngxù de rén dāngrán kěyǐ gǎi chéngxù. Yīsīlán zuì dà de qíjì shì 《Gǔlánjīng》, nǐ jīntiān hái kěyǐ zìjǐ qù jiǎnyàn.) “The laws of nature were created by God. A programmer can of course change his program. Islam's greatest miracle is the Quran, which you can still examine yourself today.”

b.x: প্রকৃতির নিয়ম আল্লাহরই সৃষ্টি। যে প্রোগ্রাম লেখে, সে অবশ্যই প্রোগ্রাম বদলাতে পারে। ইসলামের সবচেয়ে বড় মুজিজা হলো কুরআন, যা তুমি আজও নিজে যাচাই করে দেখতে পারো।
Q16. “What is the purpose of life? I just want to be happy.” 人生的意义是什么？

s: This question often opens hearts, especially among young Chinese who feel the pressure of 内卷 (nèijuǎn, endless competition) and emptiness; in 2023 temple visits by young people rose sharply as a search for relief [18]. In atheism you come from nothing and go to nothing, and pleasure always fades. In Islam you were created on purpose by One who knows you, life is a short test, every good deed is kept, and the heart finds rest only in remembering its Creator (13:28). Ask: “If you got everything you want, house, car, money, then what?”
中文:

如果没有真主，你从虚无来，到虚无去。伊斯兰说：你是被有目的地创造的，你做的每一件好事都有永恒的价值。心只有在记念真主时才能安宁。(Rúguǒ méiyǒu Zhēnzhǔ, nǐ cóng xūwú lái, dào xūwú qù. Yīsīlán shuō: nǐ shì bèi yǒu mùdì de chuàngzào de, nǐ zuò de měi yí jiàn hǎoshì dōu yǒu yǒnghéng de jiàzhí. Xīn zhǐ yǒu zài jìniàn Zhēnzhǔ shí cái néng ānníng.) “If there is no God, you come from nothing and go to nothing. Islam says you were created with a purpose, and every good deed you do has eternal value. The heart finds peace only in remembering God.”

b.x: আল্লাহ না থাকলে তুমি শূন্য থেকে এসেছ, শূন্যেই ফিরে যাবে। ইসলাম বলে: তোমাকে উদ্দেশ্য নিয়ে সৃষ্টি করা হয়েছে, তোমার প্রতিটি ভালো কাজের চিরস্থায়ী মূল্য আছে। আল্লাহর জিকিরেই কেবল মন শান্তি পায়।

সারকথা:

নাস্তিকদের ষোলোটি সাধারণ প্রশ্নের (আল্লাহকে কে সৃষ্টি করল, বিজ্ঞান, বিবর্তন, দুঃখকষ্ট, জাহান্নাম, স্বাধীন ইচ্ছা, জীবনের অর্থ) নম্র ও ছোট উত্তর এখানে আছে। প্রতিটির জন্য তুমি একটি ছোট চীনা উত্তর বলতে পারবে।

s.t: Chapter 4: Why Islam: the evidence in brief

s: Once a person accepts that a Creator probably exists, the next question is: “Which message is from Him?” This chapter is the short version you speak from. Part II has the full evidence with grades.

b.x: 4.1 The ladder for someone who starts with no belief

s: Most Chinese people are at step 0, so do not start with the Quran. Climb one step per conversation if needed:
Purpose.
“Do you ever ask why we are here?” Listen first (Chapter 3, Q16).
Origin.
“Did the universe come from nothing, from itself, or from a Creator?” (52:35-36; Chapter 2).
One God, no idols.
Tawhid is simple and reasonable: one Creator, no partners, no images, no middlemen.
God would communicate.
If a Creator made us on purpose, He would tell us why. So look for a message that is preserved, consistent, and contains what no human of its time could have produced.
The Quran passes that test.
Sections 4.2 to 4.6.
Living Islam.
Visit a registered mosque together (the Great Mosque of Xi'an or Niujie in Beijing are ideal), share halal food, meet Chinese Muslims. Many hearts open through experience, not debate.
中文:

如果有创造者，他一定会告诉我们为什么创造我们。所以我们要找一个保存完整、前后一致的信息。(Rúguǒ yǒu chuàngzàozhě, tā yídìng huì gàosu wǒmen wèishénme chuàngzào wǒmen. Suǒyǐ wǒmen yào zhǎo yí ge bǎocún wánzhěng, qiánhòu yízhì de xìnxī.) “If there is a Creator, He would surely tell us why He created us. So we should look for a message that is fully preserved and consistent throughout.”

b.x: যদি স্রষ্টা থাকেন, তিনি নিশ্চয়ই আমাদের জানাবেন কেন আমাদের সৃষ্টি করেছেন। তাই আমাদের এমন একটি বার্তা খুঁজতে হবে, যা পুরোপুরি সংরক্ষিত এবং শুরু থেকে শেষ পর্যন্ত সামঞ্জস্যপূর্ণ।

s: The Birmingham Quran manuscript has been radiocarbon-dated to 568-645 CE, and its text matches today's Quran [1]. The Tubingen manuscript dates to 649-675 CE and the Paris-St Petersburg codex to about 650-675 CE [2].

Western academics now treat the standard text as fixed by about 650 CE. Nicolai Sinai of Oxford: the traditional dating “ought to be our default view”; Marijn van Putten of Leiden shows that early manuscripts share spelling quirks that prove copying from one written original [3].
The Quran has also been memorised word for word in every generation, by people in every country, and is recited identically from Morocco to China.
Quran 15:9: “We have sent down the Reminder, and We will surely guard it.” A 1,400-year-old promise, still kept.
中文:

最早的《古兰经》手稿（英国伯明翰大学，碳十四测定为公元568到645年）和今天的《古兰经》文字一致。(Zuì zǎo de 《Gǔlánjīng》 shǒugǎo, Yīngguó Bómínghàn Dàxué, tàn shísì cèdìng wéi gōngyuán 568 dào 645 nián, hé jīntiān de 《Gǔlánjīng》 wénzì yízhì.) “The earliest Quran manuscript (University of Birmingham, UK, carbon-14 dated to 568-645 CE) matches the text of today's Quran.”

b.x: কুরআনের সবচেয়ে পুরোনো পাণ্ডুলিপি (যুক্তরাজ্যের বার্মিংহাম বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়, কার্বন-১৪ পরীক্ষায় ৫৬৮ থেকে ৬৪৫ খ্রিস্টাব্দ) আর আজকের কুরআনের লেখা হুবহু এক।
4.3 The Quran and the natural world

s: The Quran is not a science textbook. The honest claim is this: a book revealed in the 7th century to a man who could not read describes the natural world in ways consistent with modern knowledge, and contains no statement that science has shown to be false [4]. Use only the examples whose Arabic is plain (grade A in Part II):

r: Every living thing made from water
Life is water-based; cells are mostly water
Stages of the embryo: a drop, a clinging thing (alaqah), a chewed-like lump (mudghah), then bones clothed with flesh
Matches the visible stages of development; the embryo clings to the womb and somites look like tooth marks [5]
Three darknesses around the unborn child
Abdominal wall, uterine wall, and the membranes around the embryo
Darkness in the deep sea, waves above waves
Sunlight is absorbed in the upper 200 m; internal waves move between water layers [6]
Two seas meeting with a barrier between
Bodies of water of different salinity and density keep their identity where they meet
How rain clouds and hail form
Small clouds join, stack vertically into towering clouds, and produce rain and hail
The water cycle, understood in Europe only from the 16th century
The sun and moon each swim in an orbit
Both are in motion along orbits
The Quran calls the sun a lamp (siraj) and the moon a light (nur); the moon only reflects
Milk from between digested food and blood
Nutrients pass from the gut into blood and then to the mammary glands
The male drop determines the pair
The father's sperm determines the child's sex

s: Never fight for a single example. If someone challenges one, concede and move on. Avoid the popular items that depend on one translation (expanding universe, egg-shaped earth, iron sent down, lowest land, the Pharaoh's mummy); Part II explains why [7].
中文:

《古兰经》不是科学书，但它是一千四百年前启示给一个不识字的人的。它讲到胚胎的发育、深海的黑暗、云和雨的形成……而且没有一句话被科学证明是错的。(《Gǔlánjīng》 bú shì kēxué shū, dàn tā shì yì qiān sì bǎi nián qián qǐshì gěi yí ge bù shí zì de rén de. Tā jiǎng dào pēitāi de fāyù, shēnhǎi de hēi'àn, yún hé yǔ de xíngchéng... érqiě méiyǒu yí jù huà bèi kēxué zhèngmíng shì cuò de.) “The Quran is not a science book, but it was revealed 1,400 years ago to a man who could not read. It speaks of the development of the embryo, the darkness of the deep sea, the formation of clouds and rain... and not one sentence of it has been proven wrong by science.”

b.x: কুরআন বিজ্ঞানের বই নয়, কিন্তু এটি চৌদ্দশো বছর আগে এমন একজন মানুষের ওপর নাজিল হয়েছিল, যিনি পড়তে জানতেন না। এতে ভ্রূণের বিকাশ, গভীর সমুদ্রের অন্ধকার, মেঘ ও বৃষ্টি তৈরির কথা আছে... আর এর একটি বাক্যও বিজ্ঞান ভুল প্রমাণ করেনি।

s: The Quran challenges anyone to produce one chapter like it (2:23; 10:38; 17:88). The masters of Arabic, who had every reason to answer, never did [8].

Muhammad could not read or write (7:157; 29:48), had no teacher, and composed no poetry before age 40. Then he recited a book that fits neither Arabic poetry nor prose and shaped the Arabic language ever since.
The style never changes across 23 years of revelation, through war, peace, grief and victory. The Quran also rebukes the Prophet himself (80:1-10), which an author does not do to himself.
Rome, just defeated by Persia around 614, would win again “within a few years” (30:2-4); the Byzantine victories of 622-628 fulfilled it [9].
The believers would enter Mecca in safety (48:27), revealed when they had just been turned away; fulfilled in 629-630.

The Prophet foretold the fall of the Persian and Byzantine empires to a few hundred poor followers (Sahih al-Bukhari 3120) and that Islam would reach the east and the west (Sahih Muslim 2889). Within a century it reached China and Spain [10].
Known as al-Amin, “the Trustworthy”, before prophethood, even by his enemies.
Offered wealth and power to stop preaching; refused. He died with his armour pawned to a Jewish neighbour for barley (Sahih al-Bukhari 2916). A fraud seeks gain; he gained nothing material [11].
He forgave the people of Mecca who had persecuted him when he returned victorious in 630.
The historian W. Montgomery Watt (Oxford, 1953): “To suppose Muhammad an impostor raises more problems than it solves.” Michael Hart ranked him first in
The 100
(1978) as “the only man in history who was supremely successful on both the religious and secular levels” [12].
One God, no trinity, no idols, no priests between you and God, no original sin, no one needs to die for your sins. You pray directly to your Creator.
Guidance for every part of life (family, money, food, hygiene, justice) that has worked for 1,400 years across every culture, including China's.
The Quran repeatedly asks “Do you not think? Do you not reflect?” Faith built on reflection, not blind obedience.
People raised Muslim overwhelmingly remain Muslim: retention is above 90% in most countries surveyed [13]. (Do not claim Islam grows mainly by conversion; its global growth is mostly demographic.)
中文:

伊斯兰很简单：只有一个真主，没有偶像，你和真主之间不需要任何中间人。《古兰经》很多次问：“你们怎么不思考呢？”(Yīsīlán hěn jiǎndān: zhǐ yǒu yí ge Zhēnzhǔ, méiyǒu ǒuxiàng, nǐ hé Zhēnzhǔ zhī jiān bù xūyào rènhé zhōngjiānrén. 《Gǔlánjīng》 hěn duō cì wèn: “Nǐmen zěnme bù sīkǎo ne?”) “Islam is simple: there is only one God, no idols, and you need no middleman between you and God. The Quran asks many times: “Why do you not think?””

b.x: ইসলাম খুব সহজ: আল্লাহ একজনই, কোনো মূর্তি নেই, তোমার আর আল্লাহর মাঝে কোনো মধ্যস্থতাকারীর দরকার নেই। কুরআন বারবার জিজ্ঞেস করে: “তোমরা কেন চিন্তা করো না?”

s: University of Birmingham, “Birmingham Qur'an manuscript dated among the oldest in the world”, 22 July 2015, birmingham.ac.uk. Radiocarbon dates the parchment, not the ink; some scholars think the script is slightly later, but still 7th century.

The Bible, the Qur'an and Science
(1976); Hamza Tzortzis, “Does the Qur'an Contain Scientific Miracles?” (2013), which argues for “compatibility” rather than “miracle”.

Religious Switching Into and Out of Islam

সারকথা:

স্রষ্টাকে মানার পর প্রশ্ন আসে: তাঁর বার্তা কোনটি? কুরআনের সংরক্ষণ, প্রকৃতির সঙ্গে মিল, চ্যালেঞ্জ, ভবিষ্যদ্বাণী আর নবীজির (সা.) চরিত্র এর উত্তর দেয়; তুমি শুধু মজবুত প্রমাণ দিয়ে ধাপে ধাপে চীনা ভাষায় তা বলতে পারবে।

s.t: Chapter 5: Questions Chinese people ask about Islam

s: These come up more often than atheist arguments. Chinese people are usually curious, not hostile, so answer warmly and briefly. The Chinese course practises these in Lessons 9 and 10.

b.x: 5.1 “Isn't Islam a foreign, Arab religion?” 伊斯兰是外国的宗教吧？

s: Islam reached China in 651 CE, in the Tang dynasty, only 19 years after the Prophet's death [1]. The Great Mosque of Xi'an (founded 742) is built entirely in Chinese style. Zheng He, the Ming admiral every Chinese child learns about, was born into a Muslim family. China has about 17 to 20 million Muslims across ten ethnic groups [2]. In the 17th and 18th centuries Chinese Muslim scholars such as Liu Zhi wrote about Islam in the language of Confucius [3]. Islam is not Arab either: only about one in five Muslims is Arab, and the largest Muslim country is Indonesia. Islam is for all humanity (21:107; 49:13).
中文:

伊斯兰在唐朝（公元651年）就传入中国了，已经一千三百多年。西安大清真寺是完全中国风格的。郑和是穆斯林。中国有两千万左右穆斯林。伊斯兰不是阿拉伯人的宗教，是全人类的。(Yīsīlán zài Tángcháo jiù chuánrù Zhōngguó le, yǐjīng yì qiān sān bǎi duō nián. Xī'ān Dà Qīngzhēnsì shì wánquán Zhōngguó fēnggé de. Zhèng Hé shì Mùsīlín. Zhōngguó yǒu liǎng qiān wàn zuǒyòu Mùsīlín. Yīsīlán bú shì Ālābórén de zōngjiào, shì quán rénlèi de.) “Islam came to China in the Tang dynasty (651 CE), more than 1,300 years ago. The Great Mosque of Xi'an is completely Chinese in style. Zheng He was a Muslim. China has about 20 million Muslims. Islam is not the religion of the Arabs; it belongs to all humanity.”

b.x: ইসলাম থাং রাজবংশের সময় (৬৫১ খ্রিস্টাব্দে) চীনে এসেছে, তেরোশো বছরেরও বেশি আগে। শিআনের বড় মসজিদ পুরোপুরি চীনা ধাঁচে তৈরি। চেং হ্য (Zheng He) একজন মুসলিম ছিলেন। চীনে প্রায় দুই কোটি মুসলিম আছে। ইসলাম শুধু আরবদের ধর্ম নয়, গোটা মানবজাতির।
5.2 “Why don't you eat pork?” 你为什么不吃猪肉？

s: Short answer: God forbade it (2:173; 5:3), as He did for the Jews, and we obey the Creator the way you follow a doctor you trust without knowing every reason. Islam also forbids blood, carrion and alcohol, for purity and health; pork can carry parasites such as Trichinella and tapeworm [4]. The key idea is obedience to the One who made us. Chinese people already respect food rules (many Buddhists avoid meat). Be friendly: 清真 (halal) restaurants are everywhere in China, and a lamian shop is a perfect place to meet.
中文:

因为真主禁止了。就像你相信医生，不一定知道每一个原因。伊斯兰也禁止酒、血和死肉，都是为了健康和干净。(Yīnwèi Zhēnzhǔ jìnzhǐ le. Jiù xiàng nǐ xiāngxìn yīshēng, bù yídìng zhīdào měi yí ge yuányīn. Yīsīlán yě jìnzhǐ jiǔ, xuè hé sǐròu, dōu shì wèi le jiànkāng hé gānjìng.) “Because God forbade it. Just as you trust a doctor without necessarily knowing every reason. Islam also forbids alcohol, blood and carrion, all for health and cleanliness.”

b.x: কারণ আল্লাহ এটা নিষেধ করেছেন। যেমন তুমি ডাক্তারকে বিশ্বাস করো, সব কারণ না জেনেও। ইসলাম মদ, রক্ত আর মরা প্রাণীর মাংসও নিষেধ করেছে; এসবই স্বাস্থ্য আর পবিত্রতার জন্য।
5.3 “Why do Muslim women cover their hair? Is Islam against women?” 为什么穆斯林女人要戴头巾？
b.id: 53-why-do-muslim-women-cover-their-hair-is-islam-against-women-为什么穆斯林女人要戴头巾

s: Hijab is modesty and dignity: “judge me by my mind and character, not my body”. The Quran commands men to lower their gaze first, then women (24:30-31). Islam gave women the right to own property, inherit (4:7), receive the dower as their own (4:4), consent to marriage, and keep their own family name, 1,400 years ago [5]. The Prophet said: “The best of you are those who are best to their families” and, of a mother, “stay with her, for Paradise is beneath her feet” [6]. Where women are mistreated, that is local culture breaking Islamic law. Traditional Chinese culture also valued modesty (端庄).
中文:

头巾是女人自己的选择，代表端庄和尊严，意思是“看我的品格，不要看我的身体”。伊斯兰在一千四百年前就给了女人财产权、继承权和选择丈夫的权利。(Tóujīn shì nǚrén zìjǐ de xuǎnzé, dàibiǎo duānzhuāng hé zūnyán, yìsi shì “kàn wǒ de pǐngé, bú yào kàn wǒ de shēntǐ”. Yīsīlán zài yì qiān sì bǎi nián qián jiù gěi le nǚrén cáichǎnquán, jìchéngquán hé xuǎnzé zhàngfu de quánlì.) “The headscarf is a woman's own choice. It stands for modesty and dignity, meaning “look at my character, not my body”. 1,400 years ago Islam gave women the right to property, to inheritance and to choose their husband.”

b.x: হিজাব নারীর নিজের পছন্দ; এটা শালীনতা ও মর্যাদার চিহ্ন, এর মানে: “আমার চরিত্র দেখো, আমার শরীর নয়।” ইসলাম চৌদ্দশো বছর আগেই নারীদের সম্পত্তির অধিকার, উত্তরাধিকারের অধিকার আর স্বামী বেছে নেওয়ার অধিকার দিয়েছে।
5.4 “Isn't Islam violent? What about terrorism?” 伊斯兰不是很暴力吗？

s: The Quran says killing one innocent person is like killing all humanity (5:32), forbids forcing anyone into religion (2:256), and commands justice even toward people you dislike (5:8). Fighting is permitted only in defence against aggression (22:39-40; 2:190), and the first caliph, Abu Bakr, ordered armies never to harm women, children, the elderly, monks, trees or animals [7]. Terrorists kill mostly Muslims and are condemned by Muslim scholars worldwide. Nearly two billion Muslims live peacefully; judge a religion by its book and its best followers, not its worst. In China, do not discuss Xinjiang or politics; stay with the teachings.
中文:

《古兰经》说，杀一个无辜的人就像杀了全人类。宗教不能强迫。恐怖分子杀的大多数是穆斯林，伊斯兰学者都谴责他们。世界上将近二十亿穆斯林，绝大多数都是和平的。(《Gǔlánjīng》 shuō, shā yí ge wúgū de rén jiù xiàng shā le quán rénlèi. Zōngjiào bù néng qiǎngpò. Kǒngbù fènzǐ shā de dàduōshù shì Mùsīlín, Yīsīlán xuézhě dōu qiǎnzé tāmen. Shìjiè shang jiāngjìn èrshí yì Mùsīlín, jué dàduōshù dōu shì hépíng de.) “The Quran says killing one innocent person is like killing all humanity. Religion cannot be forced. Most of the people terrorists kill are Muslims, and Islamic scholars all condemn them. Of nearly two billion Muslims in the world, the vast majority are peaceful.”

b.x: কুরআন বলে, একজন নিরপরাধ মানুষকে হত্যা করা যেন গোটা মানবজাতিকে হত্যা করা। ধর্মে জোরজবরদস্তি নেই। সন্ত্রাসীরা যাদের মারে, তাদের বেশিরভাগই মুসলিম, আর ইসলামি আলেমরা সবাই তাদের নিন্দা করেন। পৃথিবীর প্রায় দুইশো কোটি মুসলিমের বিশাল অংশই শান্তিপ্রিয়।
5.5 “Why pray five times a day? Isn't that too much?” 为什么一天礼拜五次？

s: Each prayer takes about five minutes. It is a reset: you stop, wash and remember why you exist. Chinese people practise tai chi every morning for the body; prayer is the same discipline for the soul. Research reviews link regular religious practice with lower depression and better coping [8]. It also keeps a person honest all day: it is hard to cheat at two o'clock when you will stand before God at three.
中文:

每次礼拜只要五分钟。就像你们每天练太极是为了身体，礼拜是为了心灵。它让人一整天都记得自己是谁、为什么活着。(Měi cì lǐbài zhǐ yào wǔ fēnzhōng. Jiù xiàng nǐmen měi tiān liàn tàijí shì wèi le shēntǐ, lǐbài shì wèi le xīnlíng. Tā ràng rén yì zhěng tiān dōu jìde zìjǐ shì shéi, wèishénme huózhe.) “Each prayer takes only five minutes. Just as you practise tai chi every day for the body, prayer is for the soul. It helps a person remember all day who they are and why they are alive.”

b.x: প্রতিবার নামাজে মাত্র পাঁচ মিনিট লাগে। তোমরা যেমন শরীরের জন্য প্রতিদিন তাইচি করো, নামাজ তেমনি আত্মার জন্য। এটা মানুষকে সারাদিন মনে রাখতে সাহায্য করে সে কে আর কেন বেঁচে আছে।
5.6 “What about my parents and ancestors? Does Islam respect family?” 伊斯兰尊重家庭吗？

s: Strongly. The Quran places kindness to parents right after the worship of God (17:23-24) and commands honouring them even if they are not Muslim (31:14-15). Visiting relatives and caring for the elderly are acts of worship. Islam forbids only praying to ancestors, because prayer belongs to God alone; remembering them, visiting their graves and giving charity in their name are encouraged. Chinese Muslim scholars summed this up as 忠主孝亲, “loyal to the Lord, filial to parents” [3].
中文:

《古兰经》把孝敬父母放在崇拜真主之后。父母不是穆斯林也要孝敬。伊斯兰只是不允许向祖先祈祷，因为祈祷只属于真主。纪念和尊重祖先是可以的。(《Gǔlánjīng》 bǎ xiàojìng fùmǔ fàng zài chóngbài Zhēnzhǔ zhī hòu. Fùmǔ bú shì Mùsīlín yě yào xiàojìng. Yīsīlán zhǐshì bù yǔnxǔ xiàng zǔxiān qídǎo, yīnwèi qídǎo zhǐ shǔyú Zhēnzhǔ. Jìniàn hé zūnzhòng zǔxiān shì kěyǐ de.) “The Quran places honouring parents right after worshipping God. Even if your parents are not Muslim, you must honour them. Islam only forbids praying to ancestors, because prayer belongs to God alone. Remembering and respecting ancestors is allowed.”

b.x: কুরআন আল্লাহর ইবাদতের পরেই বাবা-মায়ের সেবা ও সম্মানের কথা বলেছে। বাবা-মা মুসলিম না হলেও তাঁদের সেবা ও সম্মান করতে হবে। ইসলাম শুধু পূর্বপুরুষদের কাছে প্রার্থনা করা নিষেধ করে, কারণ প্রার্থনা কেবল আল্লাহর প্রাপ্য। পূর্বপুরুষদের স্মরণ ও সম্মান করা যায়।
5.7 “How is Islam different from Buddhism?” 伊斯兰和佛教有什么不同？

s: Buddhism, as most Chinese know it, has no Creator, teaches rebirth, and seeks release from suffering through detachment. Islam teaches one Creator, one life, one judgement, and a life lived fully in the world (marriage, work, family) in service of God. Both value compassion, discipline and honesty. Buddhism asks “how do I stop suffering?”; Islam asks “who made me and what does He want?”. Many Chinese like that Islam has no statues, no monks and no middlemen.
中文:

佛教没有创造者，讲轮回。伊斯兰讲一个创造者、一次生命、一次审判。佛教问：怎么摆脱痛苦？伊斯兰问：谁创造了我，他要我做什么？(Fójiào méiyǒu chuàngzàozhě, jiǎng lúnhuí. Yīsīlán jiǎng yí ge chuàngzàozhě, yí cì shēngmìng, yí cì shěnpàn. Fójiào wèn: zěnme bǎituō tòngkǔ? Yīsīlán wèn: shéi chuàngzào le wǒ, tā yào wǒ zuò shénme?) “Buddhism has no Creator and teaches rebirth. Islam teaches one Creator, one life, one judgement. Buddhism asks: how do I escape suffering? Islam asks: who created me, and what does He want me to do?”

b.x: বৌদ্ধধর্মে কোনো স্রষ্টা নেই, এটি পুনর্জন্মের কথা বলে। ইসলাম বলে একজন স্রষ্টা, একটি জীবন, একবার বিচার। বৌদ্ধধর্ম জিজ্ঞেস করে: দুঃখ থেকে কীভাবে মুক্তি পাব? ইসলাম জিজ্ঞেস করে: কে আমাকে সৃষ্টি করেছেন, আর তিনি আমার কাছে কী চান?
5.8 “Can I believe in God but not follow any religion?” 我可以信神但不信教吗？
“আমি কি কোনো ধর্ম না মেনে শুধু সৃষ্টিকর্তায় বিশ্বাস করতে পারি?”

s: That is a good first step; the fitrah is awake. Then ask: if the Creator made you on purpose, would He leave you with no instructions? A company that hires you gives you a job description. Follow the evidence to the message He sent. Islam does not ask for blind faith: read the Quran in Ma Jian's Chinese translation, legally sold at mosques in China, and judge for yourself [9].
中文:

这是很好的第一步。但是，如果创造者有目的地创造了你，他会不给你任何指示吗？你可以自己读马坚翻译的《古兰经》，自己判断。(Zhè shì hěn hǎo de dì-yī bù. Dànshì, rúguǒ chuàngzàozhě yǒu mùdì de chuàngzào le nǐ, tā huì bù gěi nǐ rènhé zhǐshì ma? Nǐ kěyǐ zìjǐ dú Mǎ Jiān fānyì de 《Gǔlánjīng》, zìjǐ pànduàn.) “This is a very good first step. But if the Creator created you with a purpose, would He give you no instructions at all? You can read Ma Jian's translation of the Quran and judge for yourself.”

b.x: এটা খুব ভালো প্রথম ধাপ। কিন্তু স্রষ্টা যদি উদ্দেশ্য নিয়ে তোমাকে সৃষ্টি করে থাকেন, তিনি কি তোমাকে কোনো নির্দেশনাই দেবেন না? তুমি নিজে মা চিয়েনের (Ma Jian) অনুবাদ করা কুরআন পড়ে নিজেই বিচার করতে পারো।
